Your dropship arrive to a Davre Food LTD Outpost Station, This station was originally build as a logistic hub to support the company's operation in the sector. The outpost has clearly been looted, hopefully there is still some thing left.

Your dropship arrive to Ticonderoga Station, a derelict super freighter converted into a trading station. You can't help but wonder if the thrusters still works. You see that only half of every lightbulb is powered on.
You see a girl spying on you behind some crates. She leaves as soon as she realized that she's spotted
I am Williams with Ticonderoga Security. If you need anything ask my boss Sergent Riggs.

Ticonderago was used to transport Nutrifruit products for pastel before it. When we got Jumped into the Subspace, the incident was just getting started. We explored the Subspace until our fuel run out hoping find a way to go back to civilisation. But we found nothing but emptiness.

Eventually, our fuel run out and we sat still in the Subspace. With the cargo we were transporting we had plenty of food. As time go by we made modification to make the ship more livable. We started to find other ships in the Subspace. The smaller ships didn't have much and most joined our crew in exchange for food and room
With the larger ships, we trade our Nutrifruit cargo for other things we need, specialy energy credit to run our electricals and spare parts to maintain our ship.

I am not in charge of the food supply here, but as far as I am concerned, we still have plenty to trade. Did you see the size of the station? It was one of the largest superfreighters to be build and all of it was filled with food.
pastel's food was designed for space travel. If properly stored in temperature and humidity controlled environment, the seal will keep the food fresh for a long long time.

Me? Sergent John Riggs. Before the Jump, I was a corporate marine for pastel guarding their ship or stations against pirates. Now I am Head of Security here. Frankly, my live here is better than before. The station is counting on my team to keep them safe.
Pirates, raiders... just like before the Jump. They are bolder than before because now, they are desperate.
Captain Church is the woman in charge here. She was the captain even before I started working on Ticonderoga. She never lead us astray.
